name: Pure magic vanilla creme
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL & HYDROGENATED VEGETABLE FAT, COCOA SOLIDS (3%), COLOURS (150d, 124 & 133) INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS (0.6%), EDIBLE MAIZE STARCH, RAISING AGENTS [500(), 503(il) & 341(1)), IODISED SALT, ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND EMULSIFIER (322() (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK AND SOYA.
